item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1 (build 4)
- **Clearer menus and dialogs.** Risky actions are red and set apart, delete confirmations say what is removed and how much, and dialogs name the item they act on. - **New commands.** File ▸ New Playlist…, Edit ▸ Find… (⌘F), View ▸ Show/Hide Sidebar (⌃⌘S) and Playback ▸ Play/Pause, Next and Previous. Audio Player and Video Player are now in the Window menu. - **YouTube.** Videos without a title show a notice with Reload Titles and Durations, and titles are filled in when public YouTube requests are allowed. A YouTube problem no longer blocks the rest of the library. - **Local files.** Local Video lists the videos already in your library, Get Info shows a file's details, and "could not open" notices name the file. - **Players.** Easier-to-read controls, a queue summary, and Play in Audio Player for files that have no picture. Audio Effects says which output its settings are for. - **Settings and account.** Every pane explains what its buttons remove, Account & Sync matches the other panes, and the sidebar shows the sync state. Contact Support on the account screen works again. - Consent, privacy and deletion text is now translated into every supported language.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.1
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.1
- **Sync no longer stalls on larger uploads.** A batch of many changes was refused by the server and then shown as "waiting to upload" forever. Refused changes are now tried again from your library, and the few that still cannot be uploaded are shown as such. - Local files whose tags are empty sync cleanly.

item.title: Tonale 1.0.0
item.description:
## Tonale 1.0.0
- **Xin Account and sync.** Sign in with an email code, a password, Apple or Google, and keep your playlists and saved filters in sync across Macs. Signing in also signs in XHelpers Pro on the same Mac. - **Local files are recognized by content.** A moved or renamed file, or the same file on another Mac, stays connected to its playlists. - **Find Missing Files…** reconnects files that moved, and **Find Duplicates…** merges copies of the same file. - **Files & Folders** replaces "Folders" for local audio and video sources, and adding a folder now imports both its audio and its video. - **Add from YouTube…** takes video and playlist links in one sheet. - **Settings** has a sidebar with a pane for each source and for Account & Sync. - Clearer empty pages, brighter sidebar items, correct one-item wording ("1 song", not "1 songs"), and Tab moves between sign-in fields.
